subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should unified spend exploration be a permanent top-level Usage & Spend Settings pane, or should the aggregation be presented inside an existing shared overview?
rationale: Both placements are technically plausible, but VISION.md requires sign-off for new product surfaces and favors shared provider-driven UI; code review cannot choose the permanent information architecture.

options.title: Reuse the shared overview
options.body: Retain the aggregation model but integrate its summaries and drill-down into the existing overview after live bundle proof.

options.title: Approve the dedicated pane
options.body: Accept Usage & Spend as a permanent top-level Settings destination and own the additional navigation and maintenance surface.

options.title: Decline the permanent dashboard
options.body: Close or substantially narrow this PR if persistent cross-provider spend exploration is not a desired CodexBar surface.

recommendation.title: Reuse the shared overview
recommendation.body: Retain the aggregation model but integrate its summaries and drill-down into the existing overview after live bundle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner controls the VISION.md product-surface sign-off and has recent merge history in the affected multi-account area.
